thesis: Secondary-effect beneficiaries of a continued GLP-1/peptide surge; intersection of REAL+MATERIAL exposure AND NOT-yet-discovered (discovery_state regime).
method: Exposure verified vs filings/earnings (segment %); discovery_state(ticker) conditioning layer run on each. GDELT+google_trends UNAVAILABLE on this IP (per spec) -> leaned on StockTwits+Wikipedia+FINRA-SI+SEC-FTD. Foreign-listed names have NO US FTD/FINRA-SI feed -> positioning layer is BLIND (positioning=0 is a missing-data artifact, not low crowding).

candidates.name: Stevanato Group
candidates.exposure_detail: GLP-1-related ~19-22% of FY25 revenue, +>50% YoY; Nexa prefilled syringe + EZ-fill cartridges capacity-constrained into 2027; capex EUR295M (~89% growth). Verified vs FY25/Q1'26 6-Ks + earnings.
candidates.institutional_note: Covered by BofA/KeyBanc/MS/Wolfe but ratings split (3 Hold) and PTs CUT (BofA 30->28, KeyBanc 37->32, MS 24->19). Discovered-but-DERATED, not unknown. Retail-quiet, no short crowding.
candidates.verdict: TOP CANDIDATE — real material exposure, retail-undiscovered, uncrowded, but institutionally known/out-of-favor. Surface as a sentiment-derated quality pick, not a virgin idea.

candidates.name: AptarGroup
candidates.exposure_detail: Injectables (elastomer stoppers/PFS components) GLP-1 sales +>40% YTD, division +18-24% in H2'25, but injectables only ~19% of Pharma segment; rest is dispensing/closures unrelated to GLP-1.
candidates.institutional_note: SI subscore 0.173, no FTD spike. >$5B name -> institutional discovery UNVERIFIED by layer.
candidates.verdict: SECONDARY — real GLP-1 growth but diluted by diversified base; quiet+uncrowded. Lower exposure-materiality than STVN.

candidates.name: West Pharmaceutical Services
candidates.exposure_detail: GLP-1 elastomer (NovaPure/FluroTec) HVP + GLP-1 device now ~40% of Contract Mfg revenue; new Waterford/Kinston lines mid-25.
candidates.institutional_note: Tripped CROWDED at modest raw attention -> cap-tier/options guard; THE consensus picks-and-shovels GLP-1 name.
candidates.verdict: SKIP — real but the textbook crowded GLP-1 proxy. No edge in the divergence.

candidates.name: Hims & Hers Health
candidates.exposure_detail: GLP-1 telehealth distribution; compounded-semaglutide tailwind has regulatory/branded-supply risk.
candidates.institutional_note: StockTwits saturated (1.0), SI subscore MAXED (1.0), FTD elevated (0.41). The RCAT pattern: crowded + short-squeeze-prone.
candidates.verdict: SKIP/FADE — most-discovered name in the set. A real divergence here is squeeze-fuel, not alpha (RCAT lesson).

candidates.name: Bachem Holding
candidates.exposure_detail: Leading peptide CDMO; doubling Bubendorf (Building K) + Vista to ~1 metric ton; direct GLP-1 API capacity.
candidates.institutional_note: positioning=0 is a US-feed BLIND SPOT (CH-listed, no US FTD/SI). Bachem is a WELL-KNOWN crowded GLP-1 CDMO trade in EU markets; the layer cannot see EU positioning.
candidates.verdict: SKIP — exposure real but the UNDISCOVERED tag is a positioning blind-spot artifact (foreign listing). Known/crowded in reality.

candidates.name: PolyPeptide Group
candidates.exposure_detail: FY25 revenue ~EUR389M (+15.6%), GLP-1/metabolic the primary driver; EBITDA margin 7.5%->11-12% on operating leverage; doubling Malmo SPPS + Belgium ramp; mid-term ambition = 2x 2023 rev by 2028.
candidates.institutional_note: Both scores 0 = NO US signal at all (no US article/StockTwits + no US positioning feed). UNDISCOVERED here = UNMEASURED, not verified-quiet. Smaller-cap turnaround CDMO with operating leverage = the most interesting pure-play, but layer cannot condition it.
candidates.verdict: WATCH — best fundamental second-order story (operating-leverage CDMO turnaround on GLP-1) BUT discovery UNVERIFIABLE on US feeds; needs an EU positioning read before sizing.

candidates.name: Ypsomed Holding
candidates.exposure_detail: Autoinjectors +33.6% (YpsoMate 1.0/2.25ml); 44 new projects; first approved GLP-1/glucagon (Mazdutide) on YpsoMate.
candidates.verdict: WATCH — strong pure-play exposure; discovery UNVERIFIABLE on US layer.

candidates.name: Gerresheimer
candidates.exposure_detail: Targeted EUR200M GLP-1 FY25 (CagriSema dual-chamber syringe for Novo) -> but Novo CagriSema trial disappointment + Feb'25 filing delay on syringe quality; oral-GLP-1 + single-chamber commoditization threat.
candidates.institutional_note: FALSE-NEGATIVE: DE-listed -> no US positioning; in reality an ACTIVE SHORT TARGET (Morpheus Research report alleging accounting games + GLP-1 driver at risk), 3x guidance cuts, IFRS15 revenue-recognition review.
candidates.verdict: DO NOT SURFACE AS BUY — UNDISCOVERED tag is a positioning blind-spot. This is a contested battleground/short, the opposite of an unpriced beneficiary. RCAT-in-reverse.

candidates.name: Amphastar
candidates.exposure_detail: Generic GLP-1 program targeting a crowded ~$300M market; not a sizable driver. Peptide tag = narrative, not material.
candidates.institutional_note: discovery I/O-blocked; moot (exposure fails the materiality gate).
